Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

RealStudyBackend is implemented and the real conformance subclass exists; the recovered consolidation also documents native density, pair-window and ungrouped-report routes. It remains intentionally incomplete: grouped reports refuse without persisted contrast direction, and legacy result/preview/query/trial adapters remain open. The current placement route still delegates to PlacementPreviewAdapter, which composes SourcePositions and CorrectionLedger in studio-core, so it does not yet meet the no-studio-science requirement. Finish those adapters, bind preview to prepared-plan identity, and rerun real E2E/adversarial acceptance with the explicit fake-ticket recheck list.

Disposition: Keep open.
